_description: Gold expectations for benchmark fixtures. Each key is a fixture name, value is the expected scan/model output.

test-file-trap.description: Test files in tests/ dir must be classified as test, produce no RouteRecords

fixture-trap.description: Fixture files in tests/fixtures/ must be classified as fixture, produce no RouteRecords

generated-trap.description: Generated files with @generated comment + .generated.ts suffix must be classified as generated

copy-paste-trap.description: Three files with identical function names must remain distinct in the symbol index

name-collision.description: Five files each with def create() must have distinct symbols, no conflation

broken-imports.description: Imports from nonexistent modules must all be unresolved, no fabricated edges

polyglot-small.description: Mix of supported (Python, TS) and unsupported (Ruby, .foo) must all be visible with correct parse_status

unknown-foo.description: Extensionless files must be visible with parse_status=unknown

django_app.description: Django fixture — route detection, URL patterns, class views

express_app.description: Express fixture — mounted router prefixes, chained routes, middleware

fastify_app.description: Fastify fixture — plugin prefixes, hooks, schema detection

falcon_app.description: Falcon fixture — app middleware, inherited resources, add_route

go_app.description: Go/Gin fixture — grouped routes, middleware accumulation

java_app.description: Java/Spring Boot fixture — annotations, controller→service→repository layers, call edges

rust_app.description: Rust/Actix-web fixture — attributes, handler functions, struct fields
